tree.heading: In general
tree.text: In addition to any other funds authorized to be appropriated for multilateral or bilateral programs related to HIV/AIDS or economic development, there is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary of the Treasury $150,000,000 for each of the fiscal years 2001 and 2002 for payment to the Trust Fund.

tree.heading: Allocation of funds
tree.text: Of the amounts authorized to be appropriated by subsection (a) for the fiscal years 2001 and 2002, $50,000,000 are authorized to be available each such fiscal year only for programs that benefit orphans.

ancestors.heading: ASSISTANCE TO COUNTRIES WITH LARGE POPULATIONS HAVING HIV/AIDS
